name: Cordoba

queries.query: catastro municipal Córdoba Capital mapa parcelario parcelas geoportal oficial
queries.scope: Find the first-party municipal cadastre and public parcel geometry services.
queries.result: The City GeoPortal presents official maps and live GIS services. The municipal Cadastre Parcelarios page supports public block-plan lookup by cadastral nomenclature. The city GeoServer exposes CATASTRO:vm_t_parcelas through WFS; bounded anonymous requests returned full polygons and integer id_parcela values. The repository adapter passed protocol checks, but independent GEOS QA found invalid rings and overlaps in the bounded sample.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Spanish-language search, first-party city pages, WFS capabilities/schema and bounded requests for geometry plus id_parcela only; no owner/address/personal fields.

queries.query: Córdoba Argentina municipal cadastral parcel map public GIS official city cadastre
queries.scope: Cross-check city-local ownership, public access, and parcel-vector behavior.
queries.result: Official city pages identify the GeoPortal as a source of official maps and live GIS services and identify the parcel-plan viewer as a municipal Cadastre Directorate service. WFS metadata lists the CATASTRO parcel layer. A 13-cell sample around the WUP city point returned 440 unique complete polygons; all adapter protocol checks passed, but topology QA did not. The public municipal host name is informational; the reproduced topology failures determine the runtime hold.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search, first-party site inspection and anonymous WFS metadata/query checks; no credentials or personal attributes.
